semantics.personal_list: GET snippets is authenticated and author-scoped but can include project snippets; exclude project_id != null locally, retaining page scan completeness.
semantics.personal_view: Exact personal snippet, any owner visible to the authenticated identity; never claim own-only view.
semantics.project: Bind numeric project identity and exact project path before snippet reads.
semantics.visibility: Local exact public/internal/private filter, not an undocumented provider query. Private personal means creator-only; private project means project members. No secret/unlisted equivalence.
semantics.files: Current entity exposes files.path and root-ref raw URLs. Never follow returned URLs. Validate host, scope, ID, filename and ref, then construct the fixed API file route. Missing file inventory is unavailable, not an empty inventory.
semantics.authentication: GET user must succeed before listing/viewing; no anonymous fallback or credential inspection.
semantics.bounds: 30 second deadline, 10 pages of at most 100, 2 MiB response, 8 MiB operation; content defaults to 32768 UTF-8 bytes and can be lowered or raised only up to 131072. No raw/full escape.
